report.title: Adoption gate: a gem may be kept only when improvement is measured, and reverted otherwise
report.question_or_target: Specify the adopt/park/reject decision record that binds every adopted mechanism to a named before/after metric, a revert trigger and an owner-visible cost line - and back-test it against the mechanisms this estate adopted in the last two sweeps: how many would have survived their own gate?
report.evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); the back-test names each prior adoption, its metric (or the absence of one) and the verdict; adoptions with no metric are counted as WOULD-NOT-HAVE-PASSED, which is the honest reading
tests_required: negative control: the back-test must produce at least one WOULD-NOT-HAVE-PASSED verdict on a mechanism still in use; a gate that retroactively blesses everything already adopted is not a gate

last_two_sweeps_definition: Retained 2026-07-12 gem-hunt adoption record: 22 exact adoptions.
Retained 2026-07-17 harness self-improvement Build Wave 1 record: 8 named mechanisms.
scope.bounded_lineage_rule: Absence means no verifiable metric in the mounted adoption lineage, never proof that no metric existed elsewhere.
scope.excluded: The 60 July-17 candidates that were survivors but not in the eight-item Build Wave 1 are not counted as adopted mechanisms.

decision_record_spec.applies_to: Every new or materially changed gem, skill, tool, workflow, rule, or harness mechanism

metric_contract.comparison_preference: Concurrent randomized or matched control; otherwise predeclared before/after with a confound log
forbidden_substitutes: test pass count without a baseline

owner_visible_cost_line.visibility_rule: The cost line is shown beside the outcome delta at every decision checkpoint, not buried in implementation notes.

revert_contract.precondition: Rollback is rehearsed or mechanically demonstrated before ADOPT is available.

required_after_trial.decision_rationale: Machine-evaluable rule result plus owner sign-off; no free-form override may erase failed evidence.

all_must_hold: Primary outcome improves in the preregistered direction by at least minimum_practical_delta.
The preregistered uncertainty rule supports that improvement.
Every guardrail stays within its ceiling.
The owner-visible cost line stays within its ceiling and net value remains positive.
Two mechanically independent probes agree on the result.

when: The candidate is promising but evidence is missing, underpowered, confounded, or temporarily blocked.
No metric was preregistered before treatment.
constraints: A named settling experiment, owner, and expiry date are mandatory.
Expiry without evidence becomes REJECT, not indefinite PARK.

when_any: Primary outcome is neutral, harmful, or below minimum_practical_delta under the decision rule.
A guardrail or cost ceiling is breached.
The mechanism cannot be safely rolled back.
A parked trial expires without the required evidence.

all_must_hold: A fresh checkpoint still demonstrates the required outcome improvement.
Guardrails and owner-visible cost remain within ceilings.

when_any: The named revert-trigger predicate becomes true.
A scheduled checkpoint cannot reproduce the required improvement.
A guardrail or owner-visible cost ceiling is breached.
The adopted mechanism reaches its measurement deadline with no valid outcome metric.
REVERT.action: Execute rollback steps immediately, capture rollback proof, then disposition the mechanism as PARK or REJECT.
